title: Chair Box-Out and Hold
description: Partners practise the box-out technique from the chair on a shot, using chair position and wingspan to hold the spot rather than leg-based boxing out.

content.objective: Find and hold a legal box-out position from the chair long enough for a shot to come down.
content.setup: Partners sit near the block, one boxing out the other on a simulated shot.
instructions: On the shot, the defender turns the chair to get between the opponent and the basket.
Hold the position with the chair square and arms up for a two-second count.
Release and go get the rebound once the two seconds are up.
Switch roles after five reps each.
coachingPoints: Use chair position and wingspan, not pushing, to hold the spot.
Keep the chair square to the basket while holding position.
Go get the ball once boxed out — don't stop at just holding the spot.
commonMistakes: Releasing the box-out position too early to chase the ball.
Using the arms to push the opponent's chair instead of positioning legally.
Watching the shot instead of immediately finding a body to box out.
content.safety: Hold position with the body and chair only, no grabbing or pushing an opponent's chair.
